appDescription: CHABAK connects campsite discovery, travel places, parked camping stays and vehicle battery readings.

function.name: SEARCH_CAMPING_PLACE
function.description: Searches registered campsites in a selected region and displays matching places in CHABAK.

region.description: The broad region to search for campsites.

district.description: The optional city or district within the selected region.

nature.description: The optional registered natural setting of the campsite.

electric.description: Whether registered electricity facilities are required.

store.description: Whether a registered shop or convenience store is required.

function.name: SEARCH_TRIP_PLACES
function.description: Searches verified rest areas, breweries or periodic markets associated with the selected camping trip.

category.description: The type of trip place to search.

date.description: An optional calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format, used without the weekend option.

weekend.description: Whether to search the current or upcoming weekend instead of the trip date.

function.name: MANAGE_CAMPING_TRIP
function.description: Starts a parked camping stay or retrieves the current battery reading for the selected trip.
